description: Structure-based mapping of SucD catalytic His247 and CoA-binding residues onto AllF (3DMY), with CoA-pocket occupancy test and summary figure
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','MSE':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
def parse(txt,ch):
    ca={};aa={};sq={}
    for l in txt.splitlines():
        if l.startswith(("ATOM","HETATM")) and len(l)>54 and l[21]==ch:
            rn=l[17:20].strip()
            if rn not in AA3 or l[16] not in (' ','A'): continue
            ri=int(l[22:26]);an=l[12:16].strip()
            x=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])
            aa.setdefault(ri,{})[an]=x; sq[ri]=AA3[rn]
            if an=='CA': ca[ri]=x
    return ca,aa,sq
def het(txt,ch,rn):
    return [np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])
            for l in txt.splitlines() if l.startswith("HETATM") and l[21]==ch and l[17:20].strip()==rn and len(l)>54]
t3=requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/3DMY.pdb",timeout=120).text
t1=requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/1JKJ.pdb",timeout=120).text
caF,atF,seqF=parse(t3,"A"); caD,atD,seqD=parse(t1,"A")
coa=np.array(het(t1,"A","COA")); po4=np.array(het(t1,"A","PO4"))
rF=sorted(caF); rD=sorted(caD)
X=np.array([caF[i] for i in rF]); Y=np.array([caD[i] for i in rD]); nF,nD=len(rF),len(rD)
def kabsch(P,Q):
    pc,qc=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0);H=(P-pc).T@(Q-qc);U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(H)
    R=Vt.T@np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T))])@U.T
    return R,qc-R@pc
def app(R,t,P): return (R@P.T).T+t
d0=max(1.24*(min(nF,nD)-15)**(1/3)-1.8,0.5)
def dp(S):
    n,m=S.shape; V=np.zeros((n+1,m+1)); PT=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        diag=V[i-1,:-1]+S[i-1]; up=V[i-1,1:]
        src=np.where(diag>=up,0,1).astype(np.int8); tmp=np.maximum(diag,up)
        acc=np.maximum.accumulate(tmp); PT[i,1:]=np.where(acc>tmp,2,src); V[i,1:]=acc
    i,j=n,m;out=[]
    while i>0 and j>0:
        p=PT[i,j]
        if p==0: out.append((i-1,j-1)); i-=1;j-=1
        elif p==1: i-=1
        else: j-=1
    return out[::-1]
def refine(pairs,rounds=12):
    best=(-1,None,None,None)
    for _ in range(rounds):
        if len(pairs)<4: break
        R,t=kabsch(X[[a for a,b in pairs]],Y[[b for a,b in pairs]])
        Dm=np.linalg.norm(app(R,t,X)[:,None,:]-Y[None,:,:],axis=2)
        S=1.0/(1.0+(Dm/d0)**2); np_=dp(S); tm=sum(S[a,b] for a,b in np_)/nD
        if tm>best[0]:
            dd=np.array([Dm[a,b] for a,b in np_])
            best=(tm,np_,(R,t),[p for p,x in zip(np_,dd) if x<5.0])
        if np_==pairs: break
        pairs=np_
    return best
best=(-1,None,None,None)
for off in range(-nF+30,nD-30,15):
    pr=[(i,i+off) for i in range(nF) if 0<=i+off<nD]
    if len(pr)>=30:
        r=refine(pr,4)
        if r[0]>best[0]: best=r
tm,pairs,_,core=refine(best[1],20)
R,t=kabsch(X[[a for a,b in core]],Y[[b for a,b in core]])
rmsd=float(np.sqrt(((app(R,t,X[[a for a,b in core]])-Y[[b for a,b in core]])**2).sum(1).mean()))
sid=sum(1 for a,b in core if seqF[rF[a]]==seqD[rD[b]])
print(f"AllF(3DMY_A, {nF} res) vs SucD(1JKJ_A, {nD} res): TM={tm:.3f}, aligned {len(pairs)}, core<5A {len(core)}, RMSD {rmsd:.2f} A, core identity {100*sid/len(core):.1f}%")

Xt=app(R,t,X)
FAt={ri:{an:app(R,t,v[None,:])[0] for an,v in atF[ri].items()} for ri in atF}
d2f={rD[b]:rF[a] for a,b in pairs}
sites={246:"catalytic His247 (tele-phosphohistidine)",16:"CoA bind (Thr17, Gly-rich loop)",
       42:"CoA bind (Lys43)",95:"CoA bind (Ile96)",158:"CoA bind (Tyr159)"}
rows=[]
for p,lab in sorted(sites.items()):
    if p in d2f:
        q=d2f[p]; d=float(np.linalg.norm(FAt[q]['CA']-atD[p]['CA']))
        rows.append(dict(SucD=f"{seqD[p]}{p+1}",role=lab,AllF=f"{seqF[q]}{q}",CA_CA_A=round(d,2),identical=(seqD[p]==seqF[q])))
    else:
        rows.append(dict(SucD=f"{seqD[p]}{p+1}",role=lab,AllF="unaligned",CA_CA_A=np.nan,identical=False))
tab=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print("\n=== Structure-based mapping of SucD functional residues onto AllF ===")
print(tab.to_string(index=False))

tgt=atD[246]['NE2']; near={}
for ri,d in FAt.items():
    for an,v in d.items():
        dd=float(np.linalg.norm(v-tgt))
        if ri not in near or dd<near[ri][0]: near[ri]=(dd,an)
top=sorted((v[0],k,v[1]) for k,v in near.items())[:8]
print("\nAllF residues occupying the SucD catalytic-His pocket:")
for dd,ri,an in top: print(f"   {dd:5.2f} A  AllF {seqF[ri]}{ri} ({an})")
hs=sorted((float(np.linalg.norm(FAt[ri]['CA']-tgt)),f"H{ri}") for ri in FAt if seqF[ri]=='H')[:3]
print("   nearest AllF His (CA to His246 NE2):", hs)

allxyz=np.array([v for ri in FAt for v in FAt[ri].values()]); tree=cKDTree(allxyz)
dmc,_=tree.query(coa); dmp,_=tree.query(po4)
print(f"\nCoA site: {len(coa)} CoA atoms | min {dmc.min():.2f} A | clash<2.5A {(dmc<2.5).sum()} | contact<4A {(dmc<4).sum()} | >6A {(dmc>6).sum()}")
print(f"Phosphate site: {len(po4)} atoms | min {dmp.min():.2f} A | clash<2.5A {(dmp<2.5).sum()}")

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(16.5,5))
ax=axes[0]
dd=np.array([np.linalg.norm(Xt[a]-Y[b]) for a,b in pairs])
ax.plot([rD[b]+1 for a,b in pairs],dd,lw=1.2,color="#2b6cb0")
ax.axhline(5,ls="--",c="grey",lw=0.8); ax.axvline(247,color="#c53030",lw=1.5)
ax.annotate("SucD His247",(247,dd.max()*0.92),color="#c53030",fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel("SucD residue (UniProt numbering)"); ax.set_ylabel("Ca deviation (A)")
ax.set_title(f"AllF 3DMY superposed on SucD 1JKJ\nTM-score {tm:.2f}, {len(core)} core residues, RMSD {rmsd:.2f} A")
ax=axes[1]
y=np.arange(len(rows))
ax.barh(y,[0 if r["AllF"]=="unaligned" else 1 for r in rows],color="#90cdf4",label="structurally aligned")
ax.barh(y,[1 if r["identical"] else 0 for r in rows],color="#c53030",label="residue identity kept")
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels([f'SucD {r["SucD"]} -> AllF {r["AllF"]}' for r in rows],fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlim(0,1.35); ax.set_xticks([0,1]); ax.set_xticklabels(["no","yes"])
ax.set_title("Catalytic and CoA residues of SucD in AllF\n(0 of 5 kept)"); ax.legend(fontsize=8,loc="lower right")
ax=axes[2]
ax.hist(dmc,bins=np.arange(0,17,1),color="#2f855a",edgecolor="w")
ax.axvline(4,ls="--",c="#c53030"); ax.annotate("contact limit 4 A",(4.2,ax.get_ylim()[1]*0.85),fontsize=8,color="#c53030")
ax.set_xlabel("distance, modelled CoA atom to nearest AllF atom (A)"); ax.set_ylabel("CoA atoms")
ax.set_title(f"SucD CoA mapped into AllF\n{(dmc<2.5).sum()} clashes, {(dmc<4).sum()}/{len(coa)} atoms in contact")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
